title.zh: 苹果称iPhone Duo预购需求「非同寻常」，发货排期延至明年1月底
title.en: 苹果称iPhone Duo预购需求「非同寻常」，发货排期延至明年1月底

current_state.zh: Apple said preorder demand for its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, was 'unusual,' pushing delivery estimates from November to late January 2027 across all storage and color configurations, with the $1,999-$3,200 device constrained by industry-wide memory chip shortages.
current_state.en: Apple said preorder demand for its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, was 'unusual,' pushing delivery estimates from November to late January 2027 across all storage and color configurations, with the $1,999-$3,200 device constrained by industry-wide memory chip shortages.
